policies.title: PAM accepts empty passwords (nullok)
policies.description: Checks that pam_unix in the auth stack does not allow blank passwords.
policies.rationale: nullok lets accounts with an empty password log in.
policies.absence_note: Without a pam_unix auth line there is nothing to flag.
policies.remediation: Remove nullok from the pam_unix auth line.

policies.title: PAM stores passwords with a weak hash
policies.description: Checks that pam_unix password changes do not select MD5/DES.
policies.rationale: Old hashes are quick to crack offline.
policies.absence_note: No explicit algorithm means the system default applies.
policies.remediation: Use sha512 or yescrypt on the pam_unix password line.

policies.title: No account lockout module is configured
policies.description: Checks that failed logins are counted and eventually lock the account.
policies.rationale: Without lockout, online password guessing is unthrottled. The module may live in an included file, which is not followed.
policies.remediation: Add pam_faillock (or equivalent) to the auth stack.
policies.negative:
auth required pam_faillock.so preauth
auth required pam_unix.so

policies.title: pam_permit used as sufficient in the auth stack
policies.description: Checks that pam_permit never grants authentication by itself.
policies.rationale: A sufficient pam_permit in auth lets every login succeed.
policies.absence_note: No pam_permit line, nothing to flag.
policies.remediation: Remove it or make it required behind a real authentication module.

policies.title: su is not restricted to a group
policies.description: Checks that su requires membership of a trusted group.
policies.rationale: Open su lets any account that learns the root password escalate.
policies.absence_note: Evaluated explicitly; applies only to files that look like the su stack (pam_rootok present).
policies.positive:
auth sufficient pam_rootok.so
auth required pam_unix.so
policies.negative:
auth sufficient pam_rootok.so
auth required pam_wheel.so use_uid

policies.title: A PAM module runs with debug enabled
policies.description: Checks that no PAM module line carries the debug option.
policies.rationale: Debug output from authentication modules can include sensitive data in logs.
policies.absence_note: No module lines, nothing to flag.
